releases.notes:
Diorama 0.7.0 draws your whole singleplayer world on the map from its save, in minutes on most graphics cards. It also adds another dimension's map to the map screen, held torches lighting up the cave map, and fixes for two crashes.

### New

- **The map fills in from your world save.** In singleplayer the map now draws every finished chunk in the save as you play, including areas you never walked and worlds pre-generated with tools like Chunky. That includes Nether ground you haven't been to. A 5,000 by 5,000 block world took about 6 minutes on an RTX 4070, and about 30 minutes on the processor. It's on by default. Turn off **Fill in from world save** in Settings if you'd rather see only where you've been.
- **GPU baking is on by default.** Map tiles now draw on your graphics card, so they appear much sooner while you fly and when you open the map. If anything goes wrong on your card, Diorama goes back to the processor by itself and remembers that for your card and driver. This turns on once for everyone, including anyone who turned it off before. You can turn it off again in Settings and it stays off.
- **Held lights on the cave map.** A torch or lantern in a player's hand now lights up the cave around them on the map and minimap (thanks to LegendarySpy).
- **See other dimensions from the map.** A square at the bottom left of the map moves through the saved map of each dimension you've visited. You can teleport to another dimension from the right-click menu, the waypoint list and the waypoint editor.
- **Waypoint size.** Separate sizes for the minimap, the map and the world, in Settings.
- **Copy coordinates.** The map's right-click menu can copy a spot's coordinates.
- **Game time under the minimap.** Off by default. Pick it on the Minimap tab: day and time, or time only, in 24h or 12h. The time turns blue when it's dark enough to sleep.
- **Dropped items on the radar.** Items on the ground show as small aqua dots on the minimap and the map. Hover one on the map for its name and distance. It's on by default, with a tick box on the Radar tab.
- **Pixelmon.** Pokémon show their own sprites on the radar instead of green squares.
- **Resource packs can change the minimap frame.** The frames are now pictures in `assets/diorama/textures/gui/minimap_frame/`, for square and round minimaps.
- **Japanese translation** (thanks to twister716) and **Traditional Chinese translation** (thanks to TaCraft-Sociality). Russian, Belarusian and Simplified Chinese are up to date too (thanks to Gazmanovich and TaCraft-Sociality).

### Changes

- Map tiles look sharper on high-density screens (thanks to LegendarySpy).

### Fixes

- Fixed the game crashing at startup with mods that register Xaero's network channels, such as BuildPrint. Tracked players still work with those mods.
- Fixed a crash on world load in big modpacks when a mod's block fails as Diorama looks it up. The map treats that block as a solid block, and the log names it.
- With Natural Waters installed, water on the map was grey on 26.x and one flat blue on 1.21.x. It now has the mod's colours.
- A build far above the ground, in a world taller than normal, no longer leaves a white strip down the map.
- A mouse button bound to Open map now closes the map too. A mouse button bound to the waypoint list now opens the list from the map.
- Waypoint initials stay as you typed them, instead of turning into capitals.
- On 26.3, sleeping in a straw bed no longer moves your Bed pin.

releases.notes:
Diorama 0.6.0 runs on Forge for Minecraft 1.20.1, lets you draw on the map, save it as an image and keep several maps per dimension, and fixes two crashes with other mods.

### New

- **Forge 1.20.1.** Diorama now runs on Minecraft 1.20.1 with Forge.
- **Draw on the map.** A pencil button on the map gives you a pen, straight lines, filled areas and text notes, plus a measuring tool that reads distance and direction. Drawings also show on the minimap unless you turn that off.
- **Save the map as an image.** Export an area you pick, or the whole map, as a PNG. Your drawings are included.
- **Several maps per dimension.** A Maps button on the map makes, switches, renames and deletes maps, so one server or world can have separate maps. The map in use is named in the corner.
- **Waypoint icons.** Pick an icon for a waypoint instead of letters. Your bed gets a pin of its own.
- **Waypoint initials of up to four letters.**
- **Waypoint distance setting.** Show only waypoints within a distance, on the screen and the minimap.
- **Enlarge minimap key.** Hold it for a bigger minimap. It has no key until you set one.
- **Minimap opacity setting** (thanks to bottledpepsi).
- **FTB Chunks claims** show on the map and minimap.
- **Radar settings for the minimap and the full map separately.**
- **Teleport command setting** for servers that don't have `/tp`.
- **Settings to hide the map's Waypoints and Settings buttons** and its Add waypoint items.
- **Russian and Belarusian translations** (thanks to Gazmanovich).

### Changes

- The minimap hides under every screen except chat, and during Cobblemon battles.
- Waypoints in the world draw under the HUD and screens, not over them.

### Fixes

- Fixed a crash on joining a world with some mod combinations, such as Macaw's Regions Unexplored with Regions Unexplored 0.6.3.
- Fixed a crash when opening the cave map over blocks a mod creates on the fly, such as Epic Fight's cracked ground. Those blocks now show on the map as the block they belong to.
- Less stutter on 1.21.8 and older when many chunks change at once, for example when a Create contraption moves, especially with Lithium installed.
- Fixed a freeze when crossing dimensions with Immersive Portals.
- With Xaero's mods installed, the map now picks up the level IDs servers send, so each server world keeps its own map.
- The right-click menu works on map areas drawn by Diorama 0.3.0 or older.
- Waypoints and map markers no longer jitter as you move (thanks to LegendarySpy).
- The map's status line no longer runs under its Waypoints and Settings buttons.

releases.notes:
Diorama 0.4.0 adds a round minimap and faces for modded mobs, and fixes two crashes and a map mix-up between worlds.

### New

- **Round minimap.** Settings > Minimap > Shape: Square or Round. Square stays the default.
- **Faces for more mobs on the radar.** Mobs Diorama has no hand-drawn face for, modded or vanilla, now mostly get a face read off their own model instead of a dot.
- **Xaero's Minimap icon packs.** Resource packs in Xaero's radar icon format change the radar icons on Diorama's map too.
- **Copycats in their material's colours.** Filled Create and Copycats+ copycat blocks draw as the block they copy, in their own shape.

### Fixes

- With GPU baking on, Minecraft 1.20.5 to 1.21.11 could close with no crash report. A bug in Java 21.0.7, the version Minecraft's launcher ships, crashed while compiling part of the GPU baker. Diorama now avoids the code that triggers it.
- A new world with the same name as one you deleted no longer shows the deleted world's map and waypoints. Worlds that already show both stay that way.
- Fixed a crash ("Image is not allocated") rebuilding block colours after a resource reload.
- GPU baking no longer turns itself off because of an OpenGL error another mod left behind.
- Copycats+ blocks no longer draw bright purple on the map.
- The minimap hides while the F3 debug screen is open, instead of covering it.
- The radar draws mob icons in a few batches, so a mob farm on the map no longer drops the frame rate.

releases.notes:
Diorama 0.3.1 fixes the map's right-click menu on places you mapped earlier.

### Fixes

- Right-click **Teleport here**, **Add waypoint here** and **Share location** now work anywhere on the saved map, not only where chunks are loaded. Before, the menu said "Nothing mapped here" after a restart, a dimension change, or a long trip. The coordinates shown under the cursor work there too.
- Places mapped with an older version get this the next time you visit them, since their height was never saved.
